# Fase 33 etapa 11 (G1, D295): whole gold, one vector per line. There is no decimal in the game's
# money, so a price is rounded UP to whole gold: max(1, ceil(x - 0.001)) for x > 0; 0 (no price)
# and a negative (the -1 of an ingredient that does not resolve) pass through. The 0.001 keeps a
# figure that is whole in exact arithmetic (float32 noise: 6.0000005) on the same side in Papyrus,
# C++, Python and the panel. Read by the Python reference tests (test_dish_price.py), ui-prisma/tests/price-and-state.test.ts
# and plugin-skse/tests/test_dish_price.cpp; the Papyrus side is held to the same numbers by the harness
# items PRC50-PRC56 in HWTest_HonestWork.psc.
#
# The expected values were worked out apart from the code under test (plain arithmetic), not produced by it.
#
#   input expected
#
1.01 2
2.0004 2
2.002 3
0.2 1
0.0005 1
7 7
0 0
-1 -1
6.0000005 6
1.65 2
2.47 3
5.44 6
80.58 81
10.5 11
0.999 1
1.0011 2
